answer: Every defence that trusts the applicant fails the same way, so this one trusts the paper trail instead. Secure enclave key age builds the trail as a key that has never left the enclave in three years. The juniper of the scheme is the slow accrual - the credential strengthens month by month and cannot be rushed by paying more. A farm wanting a hundred accounts must wait a hundred times, and the jade in each wait is a human being present in person, paying fees and signing forms. The ember that seals it is the verifier, who reads dates instead of promises.
